<!-- pr-reviewer: 2f7f4aaf6316b8356e182bb9fc55905baf6acc98 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects contour toolpaths and can change posted G-code.

What looks good:

- The picked ring has equal tab spacing. Rings without a pick keep the old layout.
- Control compensation and an exit point with tabs are still refused by name.
- The decision record describes the scope of this slice of #1473.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| motion library | 402 passed, 6 ignored |
| `contour_start` | 16 passed |
| `contour_inside_ramp` | 2 passed |
| `lead_room` | 4 passed, 1 ignored |
| `level_links` | 12 passed |
| `machining2d` | 66 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate dry run selected unrelated batch work because the trial merge was not committed. I used the source test maps to select the suites above. No GitHub runner was used. No golden files changed. No UI files changed, so screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge:

1. **P1 — `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:241`: keep leads out of standing tabs.** The new layout puts a tab immediately before the pick. The lead checks use the part boundary, which does not include this tab. The generator now accepts a picked start with tabs and a linear lead, then cuts through the tab. This can remove material that must hold the part. Make the lead and extension checks include the standing tabs, or refuse the unsafe combination by name. Add tests for both a linear lead-in and an independent linear lead-out.

I ran two fixture mutations of `a_picked_start_with_tabs_enters_every_level_at_its_projection`. I kept the PR source unchanged. Test copies and a small Cargo manifest were in `/tmp`; Cargo used the review worktree's target directory. I repeated the probes with the trial merge's Cargo.lock versions. The original test passed. Both mutations failed its existing assertion, `the tab before the pick stands`:

- **Linear lead-in:** set `p.lead = Lead::Linear { length: 5.0 }` and `p.links.approach.lead_out = Some(Lead::None)`. The floor feed runs from `(43, 25, -4)` to `(43, 20, -4)`.
- **Linear lead-out:** keep the perpendicular lead-in and set `p.links.approach.lead_out = Some(Lead::Linear { length: 5.0 })`. The floor feed runs from `(43, 24, -4)` to `(43, 19, -4)`.

Both moves cross the intended 4 mm tab at `x = 43`, `20 < y < 24`, below its top at `z = -3`. The test's probe point `(43, 22)` is cut at `z = -4` in both cases.

Note: `contour.rs` was already over 400 lines and grows by six lines in this PR. A later split can address this; it is not a blocker here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
